issues.failure_explanation: The definitions only state that derivatives of node and edge functions lie in the original edge and face spaces, not in the serendipity subspaces. The commuting diagrams are proved for interpolants of smooth functions, not for arbitrary elements of the serendipity virtual spaces. Hence the claimed inclusions nabla V^{Sn} subset V^{Se} and curl V^{Se} subset V^{Sf} are unsupported.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must prove the derivative inclusions for arbitrary serendipity virtual functions or modify the space definitions so that these inclusions hold by construction.
issues.overall_effect: The paper's claim that the stabilization-free method applies to operators nabla, curl, and div by an exact sequence of serendipity spaces is not established. In particular, using the stable polynomial projection on derivatives of serendipity virtual functions is unjustified.
issues.title: Serendipity exact-sequence inclusions are asserted without proof
